name: Media Manager: TV & Movies
shortDescription: Organize TV shows and movies with rename previews, artwork, and device pairing.
fullDescription:
Bring order to your TV shows and movies with Media Manager. Connect a folder on your device or pair with your own desktop library, match titles, and review proposed changes before renaming.

ORGANIZE YOUR LIBRARY
• Manage TV shows by season and organize movies in one workspace.
• Preview proposed filenames before applying changes.
• Choose None, Plex, or Jellyfin naming formats.
• Customize episode numbering and specials mapping.
• Rename matching subtitles, external audio, and NFO files alongside videos.
• Reuse saved naming profiles.

FIND TITLES AND ARTWORK
• Search metadata providers, including TVmaze, OMDb, and TMDB, with custom provider options.
• Include an optional release year to narrow matching results.
• Browse local posters and provider alternatives.
• Compare existing and selected artwork before replacing it, or download available posters.

CONNECT YOUR DEVICES
• Use Android’s folder picker to choose a local media folder.
• Scan a pairing QR code from Media Manager on your desktop to connect to your own library server.
• Access a paired library over a local network or a configured remote HTTPS connection.

REVIEW AND PLAY
• Inspect selected media and play video previews.
• Use the compatibility player for additional format support; playback depends on the file, codec, and device.
• Check library health for missing episodes and naming issues.
• Review rename history and restore original names where supported.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
Local library operations run on your device. Remote operations run on the desktop or server you connect. Online metadata and artwork features require internet access, and some providers require your own API key. Remote pairing requires a running Media Manager backend and a reachable connection.

Media Manager organizes media you already have. It does not include a movie or TV streaming catalog, and it does not supply video downloads.

The app contains advertisements, including optional rewarded ads that grant temporary ad-free time.

Media Manager is an independent app and is not affiliated with Plex, Jellyfin, or the metadata providers listed above.
